findings.highlight: the wound he received from Lancer.
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに刺された肩
findings.explanation: The exact right-shoulder injury governing Shinji’s disabled arm is generalized.

findings.highlight: he imagines his wounded arm rotting away.
findings.evidenceJa: この傷が崩れ落ちる自分の姿を想像した
findings.governingReading: he imagines himself collapsing from this wound.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s vision of his whole body collapsing becomes localized arm rot.

findings.highlight: he imagines everyone around him rotting away. Not just one of their arms.
findings.evidenceJa: まわりの人間全てが同じように崩れ落ちる姿を妄想した。
findings.governingReading: he fantasizes that everyone around him collapses in the same way.
findings.explanation: The repeated whole-person collapse is rewritten as bodily rot and then arm-specific mutilation.

findings.highlight: He has one arm. All the other idiots should lose both of their arms.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の姿が姿なのだ。他のバカどもは身を弁えてより一層醜い姿になるべきだろう。
findings.governingReading: Given his own appearance, the other fools ought to know their place and assume forms uglier still.
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a numerical one-arm/two-arm revenge scheme absent from the source.

findings.highlight: The girl that did not become his.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の思い通りにならなかった少女。
findings.governingReading: The girl who refused to go as he wanted.
findings.explanation: Failure to control Rin becomes failure to possess her as his property.

findings.highlight: he cannot allow her to be superior to him.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分より優れた造形である事は許されない。
findings.governingReading: he cannot tolerate her having a form more finely made than his.
findings.explanation: Shinji’s body-focused envy and mutilation fantasy become generic superiority.

findings.governingReading: With his mind afflicted by fever
findings.explanation: Fevered cognition becomes the literal or idiomatic image of a head on fire.
Shinji’s accusation that Gilgamesh is incapable becomes an intelligence judgment.
The sound is reinterpreted as piercing, prematurely asserting ordinary wound mechanics that the next page denies.

findings.highlight: The Servant’s arm is in his body
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の腹に溶け込んでいた。
findings.governingReading: The Servant’s arm has melted into his abdomen.
findings.explanation: The supernatural fusion central to the medium operation is omitted.

findings.highlight: If you want it so much, do not let go of it.
findings.evidenceJa: 大事なものなら二度と手放すな
findings.governingReading: If it is precious to you, never let it go again.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s cruel maxim about guarding a precious possession becomes a comment on intensity of desire.

findings.highlight: the sensation of billions of worms, squirming through his body and trying to get out
findings.evidenceJa: 体の中に蠢く異物、群れひしめき合うような感覚
findings.governingReading: a foreign object writhing inside him, followed by the sensation of a densely packed swarm.
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents billions of worms and an attempt to escape the body where the source deliberately leaves the foreign mass unidentified.

findings.highlight: Unable to bear the pain of the repeating growth and decay and the sensation of “something” wriggling inside of him
findings.evidenceJa: 際限のない増殖と死滅を繰り返す痛みより、自身の中にびっしりと蠢き回る“何か”の不快感に耐えられず
findings.governingReading: Unable to bear the revulsion of the densely writhing “something” inside him even more than the endless pain of growth and death
findings.explanation: The source explicitly makes the unknown internal swarm more intolerable than the pain; the English joins them as equal causes.

findings.highlight: the Servant lets him go as if nothing has happened.
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは何事もなかったように身を離す。
findings.governingReading: the Servant withdraws his body as though nothing happened.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh physically steps away after observing the transformation; the English implies he releases Shinji from restraint.

findings.highlight: the Holy Grail should figure out its master soon enough.
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯はすぐに依り代の使い方を覚える筈だ。
findings.governingReading: the Grail should soon learn how to use its anchor.
findings.explanation: Adaptation to operating through the anchor becomes identifying or understanding its Master.

findings.evidenceJa: ゲテモノの方が味はよい。
findings.governingReading: Grotesque or bizarre fare tastes better.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s culinary metaphor for unusual, repellent fare becomes a generic claim about ugliness.

findings.evidenceJa: なによりオマエならば

findings.explanation: The final image places transformed Shinji in Gilgamesh’s figurative and literal shadow; the English moves him alongside.
